basic_info.description: A rare find, this bi-level Marina home features 4 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, a private patio, an exclusive 2-car garage w/ interior access & an exclusive roof deck with iconic GG Bridge views. Extensively remodeled with system upgrades, it's just minutes from Chestnut St, Fort Mason, & Marina Green. Not in a liquefaction zone. The entry opens to the upper level, featuring 4 bedrooms and 3 full bathrooms, including 2 en-suite bedrooms with bay windows overlooking the yard. The primary suite features a luxe walk-in shower & a stand-alone soaking tub. The entertaining level has an open-concept layout with a custom wood accent wall, dedicated dining area & opens to a private patio as well as the large shared yard. A full bathroom on this level adds functionality for daily use or guests. The adjacent kitchen features quartz countertops, ample cabinet space, and stainless steel appliances including a 6-burner gas range, microwave drawer, wine fridge, & a dedicated bar sink. The building has undergone a extensive renovations, featuring upgrades to its structural, electrical, plumbing, heating, windows,  safety systems. 400-amp electrical system, new fire alarm & sprinkler systems in common areas, shear walls, beams, and seismic strengthening. A must see.
